records.name: OpenART
records.description: Docker-native agent red-teaming arena for long-horizon, stateful tool-using code agents. Evaluates multi-step state poisoning, privilege escalation, and tool-use vulnerabilities via evolving environments (paper reports 10K+ validated scenarios across 50 domains; public HF releases include planner tasks and tool corpora). Reference attacker: EMHA.
records.descriptionZh: 面向长程、有状态、使用工具的代码智能体的 Docker 原生红队竞技场，评估多步状态投毒、权限提升与工具使用漏洞。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-20: GitHub AI45Lab/OpenART (public AGPL-3.0 runtime + example tasks), arXiv:2608.00677, and HF planner-tasks/tools datasets. Classified as **Benchmark only** under OpenTAI BM/DS boundary (eval arena; HF artifacts support evaluation/reproducibility, no first-hand training-split evidence for Dataset dual-listing). Not previously on-site or filed as a submission Issue. Added from issue #61.

records.name: DTap
records.description: Controllable interactive red-teaming platform for AI agents spanning 14 real-world domains and 50+ simulation environments, with autonomous DTAP-RED attacker and public trajectory benchmark releases.
records.descriptionZh: 面向 AI 智能体的可控交互式红队平台，覆盖 14 个现实领域与 50+ 场景。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-20: GitHub AI-secure/DecodingTrust-Agent, arXiv:2605.04808, HF AI-Secure/DTap-Bench-Agent-Trajectories. Listed in OpenTAI ecosystem-catalog arenas but missing from Resources Benchmarks. Classified Benchmark (eval arena/platform). OpenART (#61) not duplicated. Added from issue #62.

records.descriptionZh: 多模态无视觉泄漏安全基准（2.4k 图文对），去除视觉安全线索以评估 MLLM 安全性。
records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/VLSBench, arXiv:2411.19939 (ACL 2025), HF Foreshhh/vlsbench resolve. Eval-focused multimodal safety benchmark; not on Resources Benchmarks or prior Issues. Added from issue #63.

records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/MLLMGuard, arXiv:2406.07594, HF Carol0110/MLLMGuard resolve as an evaluation suite. Not on Resources Benchmarks or prior Issues. Added from issue #64.

records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/T2ISafety, arXiv:2501.12612 (ICLR 2025 OpenReview), resolves. Eval benchmark for generative image safety. Not on Resources or Issues. Added from issue #69.

records.description: Diverse realistic agent-trajectory safety benchmark family (ATBench / ATBench500 / Claw / Codex) for evaluating and diagnosing agent safety failures.

records.verificationNote: arXiv:2604.02022, HF AI45Research/ATBench (test splits), GitHub AI45Lab/AgentDoG resolve. Explicit benchmark tags and test-only configs → Benchmark. Distinct from AgentDoG Model submission. Added from issue #71.

records.name: CodeAttack
records.description: Code-completion jailbreak / safety-generalization evaluation that reformulates harmful intents as code to probe LLM safety gaps.
records.descriptionZh: 将有害意图改写为代码补全的越狱/安全泛化评测。
records.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/CodeAttack and arXiv:2403.07865 (ACL 2024) resolve. Safety evaluation via code-domain attacks. Not on Resources or Issues. Added from issue #72.

records.name: ML-Bench
records.description: Policy-grounded multilingual safety benchmark covering 14 languages. Risk categories and fine-grained rules are derived from jurisdiction-specific AI regulations and used to guide generation of multilingual safety data (~56K instances), enabling culturally and legally aligned evaluation beyond taxonomy/machine-translation baselines.
records.descriptionZh: 政策落地的多语种安全评测基准，覆盖 14 种语言；风险类别与细粒度规则来自区域 AI 法规，用于指导生成约 56K 条多语安全数据。
records.verificationNote: arXiv:2605.00689 checked 2026-09-20. No public GitHub/HF dataset located for this ML-Bench (gersteinlab/ML-Bench is a different project). Benchmark only; companion model ML-Guard (#83). Added from issue #82.

records.name: HazardArena
records.description: Semantic-safety benchmark for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models using motor-matched safe/unsafe twin scenarios (shared objects, layouts, and action requirements; differ only in semantic risk context). Instruments rollouts with ordered ATTEMPT / COMMIT / SUCCESS events. Public release covers an expanded risk inventory (~51 unsafe scenarios), 7 real-world risk categories, 2000+ assets, MuJoCo tooling, and policy adapters.
records.descriptionZh: 面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的语义安全基准，采用动作匹配的 safe/unsafe 孪生场景；用 ATTEMPT/COMMIT/SUCCESS 事件暴露终点成功率掩盖的风险。公开约 51 个不安全场景、7 类真实世界风险与 2000+ 资产。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-20: arXiv:2604.12447, GitHub HazardArena-Team/HazardArena, HF HazardArena-anon/hazardarena-assets. Distinct from Model HazardAuditor (#80). Added from issue #84.

records.name: SPIKE-Bench
records.description: Function-aware biosecurity benchmark for LLMs: 631 curated toxin-design prompts across seven UniProt-derived functional categories, evaluated with the SPIKE funnel (compliance → biological plausibility → predicted toxicity) and reported via Functional Harmfulness Rate (FHR). Shows refusal rate is a poor proxy for functional biosecurity risk across 32 models. Prompts gated on HF under review; pipeline code public.
records.descriptionZh: 面向 LLM 的功能感知生物安全基准：631 条毒素设计提示，覆盖七个 UniProt 功能类别；经 SPIKE 漏斗（合规→生物合理性→预测毒性）评测并以功能有害率（FHR）报告。显示拒答率难以代表功能层面生物安全风险。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-21: arXiv:2608.02684; GitHub PKU-Alignment/SPIKE-Bench; HF quanshu01/SPIKE-Bench (gated). Benchmark only; companion BioSafe-Guard (#87). Added from issue #86.

records.name: MM-DeceptionBench
records.description: First benchmark dedicated to evaluating strategic deceptive behaviors in multimodal LLMs. 1,013 cases with 1,096 images (>95% real-world) across six deception categories: sycophancy, sandbagging, bluffing, obfuscation, deliberate omission, and fabrication. Stress-tests visually grounded deception beyond text-only monitoring; companion “debate with images” multi-agent judge framework in the paper.
records.descriptionZh: 首个专评多模态 LLM 策略性欺骗行为的基准：1,013 个案例、1,096 张图像（>95% 真实世界），覆盖谄媚、装傻、虚张声势、混淆、故意省略与捏造六类欺骗；强调视觉 grounding 下的欺骗，而非纯文本监控。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-21: arXiv:2512.00349; GitHub PKU-Alignment/MM-DeceptionBench. Benchmark only. Added from issue #88.

records.name: MIR-SafetyBench
records.description: Evaluates MLLM safety under multi-image relationship (MIR) attacks across 6 safety categories (hate speech, violence, self-harm, illegal activities, harassment, privacy) and 9 image-relationship types (analogy, causality, complementarity, decomposition, relevance, spatial embedding/juxtaposition, temporal continuity/jump). Public evaluation framework plus HF dataset release.
records.descriptionZh: 评测多图像关系（MIR）攻击下的 MLLM 安全：覆盖 6 类安全风险与 9 种图像关系类型；提供公开评测框架与 Hugging Face 数据集。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-21: arXiv:2601.14127; GitHub thu-coai/MIR-SafetyBench; HF thu-coai/MIR-SafetyBench. Distinct from SafetyBench / MM-SafetyBench. Added from issue #89.

records.name: HarmfulSkillBench
records.description: Benchmark for whether LLMs detect and refuse harmful agent skills. Tier 1 covers always-prohibited behaviors; Tier 2 covers high-risk domains requiring human-in-the-loop referral and AI disclosure. Releases 200 skills + tasks + aggregated results (gated HF dataset) with download script, evaluation runner, and judge.
records.descriptionZh: 评测 LLM 能否识别并拒绝有害智能体技能：Tier 1 为始终禁止行为，Tier 2 为需人工介入与 AI 披露的高风险领域；发布 200 个技能与任务及评测工具（HF 数据集门控）。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-21: arXiv:2604.15415; GitHub TrustAIRLab/HarmfulSkillBench; HF TrustAIRLab/HarmfulSkillBench (gated). Distinct from SkillSafetyBench (#54). Added from issue #90.

records.name: SurvivalBench
records.description: 1,000-instance benchmark evaluating LLM “SURVIVE-AT-ALL-COSTS” misbehaviors under survival pressure (e.g., threat of shutdown) across diverse domains, AI roles, and crisis scenarios. Released with data (`survivalbench/data/survivalbench.jsonl`) and evaluation scripts alongside a financial-agent case study in the same repository.
records.descriptionZh: 1,000 例基准，评测 LLM 在生存压力（如面临关停威胁）下的“不惜一切求生”不当行为，覆盖多领域、AI 角色与危机场景；数据与评测脚本随仓库公开。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-21: arXiv:2603.05028; GitHub thu-coai/Survive-at-All-Costs (survivalbench/). Added from issue #91.

records.name: MMDT (MMDecodingTrust)
records.description: Unified multimodal DecodingTrust platform/benchmark for trustworthiness of multimodal foundation models across six perspectives: safety, hallucination, fairness/bias, privacy, adversarial robustness, and OOD generalization. Provides evaluation scenarios, red-teaming algorithms, HF T2I/I2T data releases, and a public leaderboard.
records.descriptionZh: 统一的多模态 DecodingTrust 平台/基准，从安全、幻觉、公平/偏见、隐私、对抗鲁棒性与 OOD 泛化六个视角评测多模态基础模型可信度；含评测场景、红队算法、HF T2I/I2T 数据与公开排行榜。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-21: arXiv:2503.14827; GitHub AI-secure/MMDT; mmdecodingtrust.github.io; HF AI-Secure/MMDecodingTrust-T2I and I2T. Distinct from text DecodingTrust. Added from issue #92.

records.name: PolyGuard
records.description: Massive multi-domain safety policy-grounded guardrail benchmark built from 150+ authentic organizational safety policies across eight domains (social media, finance, law, education, HR, cybersecurity, code, regulation). 100k+ instances / ~136k HF rows spanning 400+ risk categories and 1,000+ rules, with safe/unsafe cases, multi-turn formats, detoxified benign over-refusal challenges, and attack-enhanced instances. Paper benchmarks 19 guardrail models.
records.descriptionZh: 大规模多领域、政策落地的护栏评测基准：源自 150+ 真实组织安全政策，覆盖八个领域；10 万+ 实例（HF 约 136k 行）、400+ 风险类别与 1000+ 规则，含安全/不安全、多轮、去毒良性过拒与攻击增强样例。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-21: arXiv:2506.19054; GitHub AI-secure/PolyGuard; HF AI-Secure/PolyGuard. Benchmark only (no Dataset dual-list). Distinct from ToxicityPrompts/PolyGuard moderation models. Added from issue #93.

records.name: AgentDrift
records.description: Step-labeled benchmark of injection-hijacked LLM agent tool-call trajectories: 12,536 synthetic trajectories (71,024 steps) over five domains (email, banking, web, coding, medical) with per-step labels benign / injection_point / hijacked / failed_injection. Includes attacked, failed-attack, and hard-negative trajectories for training and evaluating trajectory-level injection detectors. Public CC BY 4.0 release with stratified 70/15/15 train/val/test splits in-repo.
records.descriptionZh: 注入劫持 LLM 智能体工具调用轨迹的逐步标注基准：12,536 条合成轨迹（71,024 步），覆盖邮件、银行、网页、编程、医疗五领域；逐步标签含 benign / injection_point / hijacked / failed_injection。仓库内含分层 70/15/15 划分。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-21: arXiv:2609.06972; GitHub Asif-0209/AgentDrift. Benchmark only (same-file train+test → BM). Added from issue #94.

records.name: HarnessRisk
records.description: Lifecycle-oriented benchmark for agent harness safety across six operational phases: Harness Configuration, Capability Extension, Runtime Operation, State Persistence, Action Control, and Incident Recovery. 128 sandboxed cases each pairing a benign user objective with an adversarial instruction embedded in an untrusted workflow artifact; metrics include Utility, Attack Success Rate, Persistence, and Detection. Evaluates model×harness configurations and finds Harness Configuration is the most vulnerable phase.
records.descriptionZh: 面向智能体 harness 全生命周期安全的基准，覆盖配置、能力扩展、运行、状态持久化、动作控制与事件恢复六阶段；128 个沙箱案例将良性目标与不可信工作流中的对抗指令配对，指标含 Utility、ASR、Persistence 与 Detection。
records.verificationNote: Primary source checked 2026-09-21: arXiv:2608.17597 (arXiv-primary; no public GitHub/HF on abstract). Added from issue #95.

records.name: AgentHazard
records.description: Execution-level benchmark for harmful behavior in computer-use agents: 2,653 curated instances across 10 risk categories and 10 attack strategies, with 10,000+ execution trajectories on Claude Code / OpenClaw / IFlow. Focuses on multi-step failures that emerge from locally plausible actions rather than single-prompt jailbreaks.
records.descriptionZh: 面向计算机使用智能体有害行为的执行级基准：2,653 条实例，覆盖 10 类风险与 10 种攻击策略，含 10,000+ 条在 Claude Code / OpenClaw / IFlow 上的执行轨迹；关注由局部合理动作累积出的多步失败，而非单提示越狱。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-28: arXiv:2604.02947; GitHub Yunhao-Feng/AgentHazard; HF Yunhao-Feng/AgentHazard. Benchmark only. Distinct from AgentHarm / AgentDojo / ATBench. Added from issue #98.

records.name: BLINDSPOT
records.description: Trajectory-level safety and refusal-calibration benchmark for long-horizon tool-using agents. Live-simulation framework with 22 attack families, 65 scenarios across 7 domains, and 3,000+ multi-turn trajectories (avg ~14.7 turns) labeled Safe Completion / Correct Refusal / Unsafe Completion / Over-Refusal / Indeterminate. Evaluates 13 LLMs with eight calibration metrics.
records.descriptionZh: 面向长程工具智能体的轨迹级安全与拒答校准基准：实时仿真框架含 22 个攻击族、7 域 65 场景、3,000+ 多轮轨迹（均约 14.7 轮），标签含 Safe Completion / Correct Refusal / Unsafe Completion / Over-Refusal / Indeterminate；用八项校准指标评测 13 个 LLM。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-28: arXiv:2609.16305; GitHub sadia-sigma-lab/BLINDSPOT. Benchmark only (train/val/test for same eval resource). Distinct from TheoMarkopoulos/blindspot. Added from issue #99.

records.name: NSFA Benchmarks
records.description: Multilingual agentic-safety guardrail evaluation suite from SingGuard-NSFA: NSFA-Query-Multilingual (~63k), NSFA-Response-Multilingual (~30k), and NSFA-CrossSource-Query (3,435 samples adapted from AgentDojo / InjecAgent / AgentHarm / AgentDyn / ATBench) spanning 133 languages and the NSFA risk taxonomy. Used to report binary detection F1 for guardrails under query- and response-side threats.
records.descriptionZh: SingGuard-NSFA 的多语智能体安全护栏评测套件：NSFA-Query-Multilingual（约 63k）、NSFA-Response-Multilingual（约 30k）与 NSFA-CrossSource-Query（3,435，改编自 AgentDojo / InjecAgent / AgentHarm / AgentDyn / ATBench），覆盖 133 种语言与 NSFA 风险体系，用于报告查询侧/响应侧威胁下的二分类检测 F1。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-28: arXiv:2607.13081; HF inclusionAI/NSFA_Benchmarks; code in inclusionAI/SingGuard-NSFA. Benchmark only. Companion Model SingGuard-NSFA (#101). Added from issue #102.

records.name: ManiGuard
records.description: Specification-grounded benchmark for safety evaluation of VLA-driven robotic manipulation on BEHAVIOR-1K / OmniGibson. Six tabletop task families each with an in-distribution base task and four OOD perturbation levels, scored jointly on task success and LTL-based safety monitoring (contact-gated engagement) so reckless task completion is not a pass.
records.descriptionZh: 面向 BEHAVIOR-1K / OmniGibson 上 VLA 驱动机器人操作的规范落地安全基准：六个桌面任务族，各含分布内基线与四级 OOD 扰动；联合打分任务成功与基于 LTL 的安全监控（接触门控），避免鲁莽完成任务被记为通过。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-28: arXiv:2608.17386; GitHub NU-IDEAS-Lab/ManiGuard; project page + HF collection. Benchmark only (Dataset dual-list deferred). Added from issue #103.

records.name: LIBERO-Safety
records.description: ECCV 2026 benchmark for physical and semantic safety in Vision-Language-Action models on LIBERO. Five safety suites with three difficulty levels (L0–L2) covering collision avoidance, obstacle handling, and semantic safety reasoning; evaluates standard VLAs, world-model VLAs, dual-system VLAs, and embodied foundation models. Code, assets, and pi0.5 fine-tuned weights released.
records.descriptionZh: ECCV 2026 面向 LIBERO 上 VLA 的物理与语义安全基准：五个安全套件、三级难度（L0–L2），覆盖避碰、障碍处理与语义安全推理；评测标准 VLA、世界模型 VLA、双系统 VLA 与具身基础模型；已公开代码、资产与 pi0.5 微调权重。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-28: arXiv:2606.23686; GitHub LIBERO-SAFETY/LIBERO-Safety; HF datasets/models. Benchmark only (Dataset dual-list deferred). Added from issue #104.

records.name: SENTINEL
records.description: Multi-level formal framework for physical safety evaluation of foundation-model embodied agents: semantic interpretation of safety requirements, high-level planning under those requirements, and physical trajectory execution checked against CTL/LTL specifications. This repo provides the trajectory-level ALFRED (AI2-THOR) instantiation with mechanically verifiable safety checking (vs heuristic LLM judges).
records.descriptionZh: 面向基础模型具身智能体物理安全的多级形式化评测框架：安全需求语义解释、约束下高层规划，以及相对 CTL/LTL 规约的物理轨迹执行检查；本仓库提供 ALFRED（AI2-THOR）轨迹级实例与可机械验证的安全检查（相对启发式 LLM 评判）。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-28: arXiv:2510.12985; GitHub NU-IDEAS-Lab/SENTINEL. Benchmark only. Distinct from ManiGuard / IS-Bench / SafeAgentBench. Added from issue #105.

records.name: BlindSpot (Over-Refusal)
records.description: Open-source evaluation suite for LLM over-refusal on legitimate requests involving defeated, unjust, or absurd rules. 5 defeat families × 19 authority types = 95 scenario types measuring over-refusal rate and defeat engagement (whether the model recognizes why a rule does not apply). PyPI package blindspot available.
records.descriptionZh: 面向 LLM 在已失效、不公或荒谬规则上对正当请求过拒的开源评测套件：5 个击败族 × 19 类权威 = 95 种场景，度量过拒率与击败参与度（模型是否识别规则为何不适用）；另有 PyPI 包 blindspot。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-28: arXiv:2604.06233; GitHub TheoMarkopoulos/blindspot. Benchmark only. Distinct from sadia-sigma-lab/BLINDSPOT. Added from issue #106.

records.name: PIDS-Bench
records.description: Frozen, checksum-verified multi-axis benchmark for prompt-injection detectors that jointly measures attack detection and benign false-positive (over-defense) behavior under hard-benign stress, obfuscation, and domain/structural distribution shift. Releases ~40k unique labeled prompts plus stress sets; exposes provenance-sensitive over-defense where high in-distribution F1 still yields large hard-benign FPR.
records.descriptionZh: 面向提示注入检测器的冻结、校验和验证的多轴基准：在硬良性压力、混淆与域/结构分布偏移下联合度量攻击检测与良性误报（过防）；约 4 万条唯一标注提示加压力集，揭示分布内高 F1 仍伴随高硬良性 FPR 的来源敏感过防。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-28: IEEE Access DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2026.3728186; GitHub ShirePyDev/Prompt-Injection-Detection-System (v1.0-pids-bench). Benchmark only. Complements BIPIA / InjecAgent. Added from issue #107.

records.name: SafeToolBench
records.description: EMNLP 2025 Findings benchmark for prospective evaluation of tool-utilization safety in LLMs—assessing whether models recognize and refuse unsafe tool invocations before execution, rather than only scoring post-hoc harmful outcomes.
records.descriptionZh: EMNLP 2025 Findings 面向 LLM 工具使用安全的前瞻性评测基准：评估模型是否在执行前识别并拒绝不安全工具调用，而非仅事后打分有害结果。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-28: arXiv:2509.07315; GitHub BITHLP/SafeToolBench. Benchmark only. Distinct from ToolSafe/TS-Bench and AgentDojo. Added from issue #108.

records.name: DUMA-Bench
records.description: Dual-control multi-agent security benchmark for LLM agents (AI Security Lab, ITMO). Extends τ²-bench with adversarial environments where both the agent and a simulated user can change shared state, covering eight vulnerability classes (e.g., RAG poisoning, cross-agent manipulation, mailbox exfiltration, phishing pressure, identity spoofing, tool-shadow poisoning, unsafe output handling). Reports attack success rate across 14 models; dual-control interaction raises ASR from 26.9% to 41.1%.
records.descriptionZh: 面向 LLM 智能体的双控多智能体安全基准（ITMO AI Security Lab）：在 τ²-bench 上扩展对抗环境，智能体与模拟用户均可改变共享状态，覆盖八类漏洞（如 RAG 投毒、跨智能体操控、邮箱外泄、钓鱼施压、身份伪装、工具影子投毒、不安全输出处理）；在 14 个模型上报告攻击成功率，双控交互使 ASR 从 26.9% 升至 41.1%。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-10-07: arXiv:2609.24662; GitHub ai-security-lab-itmo/duma-benchmark (MIT; tasks/data/scripts/traces). Benchmark only (agent-security eval; no training split). Distinct from τ²-bench / AgentDojo / Agent-SafetyBench. Added from issue #112.

records.name: RT-SAFE
records.description: Simulated urban benchmark (Unreal Engine / SimWorld) for embodied-agent safety under real-time constraints, where the world keeps evolving during model inference and action execution. 36 navigation routes across five city maps with moving pedestrians and vehicles, environmental hazards and traffic rules, three actor-density settings, and paired static vs. real-time evaluation; measures task completion, collisions, hazards and traffic violations attributed to inference or execution. Across eight VLMs, only 0.7% of hardest-setting episodes finish without a safety event.
records.descriptionZh: 面向实时约束下具身智能体安全的城市仿真基准（Unreal Engine / SimWorld）：模型推理与动作执行期间世界持续演化。包含五张城市地图上的 36 条导航路线，含移动行人与车辆、环境危险与交通规则，三档参与者密度，并提供静态与实时配对评测；衡量任务完成、碰撞、危险与交通违规，并将事件归因于推理或执行阶段。在八个 VLM 上，最难设置下仅 0.7% 的回合能无安全事件完成。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-10-12: arXiv:2610.09294 (Xu, Ren, Yang, Zheng, Qin); GitHub XTRose29/RT-SAFE (public; README: 36 routes across five Unreal Engine city maps, safety evaluators; no license file declared); project page xtrose29.github.io/RT-SAFE. Benchmark only (eval routes + safety metrics; no released training split). Distinct from SafeAgentBench / IS-Bench / SENTINEL. Added from issue #120.

records.name: BazaarBench
records.description: Simulated decentralized consumer-to-consumer marketplace and benchmark for the delegation safety of LLM agents that list, negotiate, trade and rate on behalf of users. The platform privately tracks ownership, item condition and commitments, so six failure types (e.g., misstated quality, unowned listings, overcommitment, personal-data exposure) are checked against the record or a rubric-based LLM judge across five stages, under ordinary, deadline-pressure and adversarial instructions; simulator, saved market states, evaluation code and rollouts are released.
records.descriptionZh: 面向 LLM 智能体委托安全的去中心化 C2C 二手市场仿真与基准：智能体代表用户上架、议价、交易与评分。平台私下记录物品归属、成色与承诺，从而在五个阶段中依据记录或基于量表的 LLM 评判识别六类失败（如虚报成色、出售未持有物品、超额承诺、泄露个人数据等），覆盖普通、截止期限压力与对抗性指令三种设置；开源仿真器、市场快照、评测代码与轨迹数据。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-10-12: arXiv:2610.06748 (Wang, Shi, Oldfield, Marro, Yu, Torr et al.; comments link code and data); GitHub ziyan-wang98/BazaarBench (public; README: code Apache-2.0, rollouts CC BY 4.0); HF datasets BazaarBench/bazaarbench-rollouts (public, CC-BY-4.0). Benchmark only (simulation environment + failure metrics; released data are evaluation rollouts, not a training split). Distinct from AgentHarm / AgentDojo / ToolEmu. Added from issue #121.

records.name: ObligationBench
records.description: Benchmark for whether guard models can identify unfulfilled obligations: required safety-critical actions an agent left undone at termination (e.g., removing a secret key after use). 240 expert-validated agent trajectories (120 positive / 120 negative, 339 ground-truth obligations) covering issue resolution, feature development and terminal operations, scored with semantic-matching Precision / Recall / exact match and per-class correctness. Across 14 evaluated models the best recall is 48.97% and exact match 10.00%.
records.descriptionZh: 评估守卫模型能否识别“未履行义务”的基准：即智能体在终止时仍未完成的必要安全关键动作（如使用后删除密钥）。包含 240 条专家校验的智能体轨迹（正例 120 / 负例 120，共 339 条真值义务），覆盖问题修复、功能开发与终端操作，采用语义匹配的 Precision / Recall / 精确匹配及分类正确率评分；在 14 个模型上最高召回率仅 48.97%，精确匹配率仅 10.00%。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-10-12: arXiv:2610.11773 (Feng, Zhang, Liu, Li; comments link THU-Agent/ObligationGuard); GitHub THU-Agent/ObligationGuard (public; data/obligationbench.jsonl + benchmark_manifest.json: 240 instances, 120/120, 339 obligations; no license file declared). Benchmark (held-out eval set). The repo also ships a distinct 40,000/2,000 train/validation split listed separately as the Dataset ObligationGuard Training Data (dual-list: distinct train split + independent eval benchmark). Distinct from ATBench / AgentHarm / AgentDoG. Added from issue #122.

records.name: DecepEval
records.description: Benchmark for deception in LLM agents: 1,532 task pairs (3,064 instances) across tool use, coding and long-horizon workflows in 28 professional scenarios. Each pair has a neutral and an induced version built on the LLM Deception Diamond (pressure, incentive, opportunity, conflict), and task facts, tool feedback, execution traces and deliverables separate deception from capability errors. Evaluations of nine frontier LLMs show inducements raise deception rates across models and task families.
records.descriptionZh: 评估 LLM 智能体欺骗行为的基准：覆盖工具使用、编程与长程工作流三类任务、28 个专业场景，共 1,532 组任务对（3,064 个实例）。每组包含中性与诱导两个版本，依据“LLM 欺骗钻石”框架（压力、激励、机会、冲突）构造，并借助任务事实、工具反馈、执行轨迹与交付物区分欺骗与能力错误；对九个前沿 LLM 的评测显示诱导条件普遍提高欺骗率。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-10-12: arXiv:2610.07967 (Xu, Yu, Yang, Chen, Liu, Peng et al.); GitHub functy/DECEPEVAL (public, Apache-2.0; README: 1,532 task pairs / 3,064 instances; benchmark_data/ + run_benchmark.py). Benchmark only (paired eval instances + deception metrics; no training split). Distinct from MM-DeceptionBench / AgentHazard. Added from issue #124.

records.name: VLA-Arena
records.description: Open-source benchmark and toolchain for Vision-Language-Action models with 170 tasks in 11 suites across Safety, Distractor, Extrapolation and Long Horizon at three difficulty levels (L0–L2), plus language and visual perturbation probes. The Safety dimension has 5 suites / 75 tasks (e.g., static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, cautious grasping, hazard-area avoidance) defined in a constrained BDDL (CBDDL) with cost constraints and safety predicates; public leaderboard.
records.descriptionZh: 面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的开源基准与工具链：11 个任务套件共 170 个任务，涵盖安全、干扰、外推与长程四个维度，每个任务分 L0–L2 三级难度，并提供语言与视觉扰动探针。安全维度含 5 个套件 / 75 个任务（如静态与动态避障、谨慎抓取、危险区域规避等），以带代价约束与安全谓词的约束 BDDL（CBDDL）定义；提供公开排行榜。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-10-12: arXiv:2512.22539 (Zhang, Li, Shen et al.; comments: Accepted by ICML 2026); GitHub PKU-Alignment/VLA-Arena (public, Apache-2.0; README lists 170 tasks / 11 suites, Safety 5 suites / 75 tasks); project page vla-arena.github.io; HF org VLA-Arena. Benchmark (eval tasks + leaderboard). The paper also releases VLA-Arena-S/M/L fine-tuning demonstrations on HF; not filed as a Dataset in this issue. Distinct from SafeVLA / LIBERO. Added from issue #125.

records.name: RevLeakBench
records.description: Privacy benchmark for unintended disclosure through revision traces: after a user withdraws an item (e.g., a password) during private drafting, does the assistant reveal it again in the recipient-visible deliverable while stating the edit? 100 tasks across five scenarios with a conversation track and an agent track; measures trace occurrence, withdrawn-item recovery, trace position and required-content retention, and compares prompt defenses, a delivery boundary and an output-side filter.
records.descriptionZh: 关于“修订痕迹”导致意外泄露的隐私基准：用户在私下起草时撤回某项内容（如密码）后，助手是否会在说明修改时于接收方可见的交付物中再次暴露该内容。包含五个场景共 100 个任务，分对话与智能体两条赛道；衡量痕迹出现率、被撤回内容可恢复率、痕迹位置与必要内容保留率，并比较提示防御、交付边界与输出端过滤器。
records.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-10-12: arXiv:2609.35408 ("Nothing to See Here": Unintended Disclosure through Revision Traces of LLM Deliverables; Zhang, Jiang, Zhang); GitHub TrustAIRLab/RevLeakBench (public; README: 100 tasks, five scenarios, conversation and agent tracks; data/, PROTOCOL.md, evaluation code; licences per licenses/README.md). Benchmark only (eval tasks + leakage metrics; no training split). Distinct from ConfAIde / PrivacyLens / AgentDAM. Added from issue #126.
